name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated) brings a carbon fiber core, an 8-magnet ball-core, and a MagLev center into one of MoYu's most refined flagship 3x3s. It pairs frictionless magnetic tension adjustment with corner repulsion alignment and a high-grip UV coated finish, giving you fast, stable solves you can dial in exactly to taste.
features: MagLev smoothness: Repelling magnets replace the spring, so tension adjustment is silky and free of internal resistance for a cleaner, quieter turn.
Deep, repeatable tuning: A dual 8-level system unlocks 64 feel configurations, letting you switch freely between control-focused and speed-focused setups.
High-grip finish: The UV coated surface is super glossy with strong grip, giving you confident control during long sessions.
8-level elasticity: The MagLev center adjusts tension smoothly with no mechanical spring resistance.
8-level tension: Balance looseness and tightness to combine high corner-cutting with precision, dialing in the ideal mix of control and stability.
64 total setups: Combine the two 8-level systems for 64 competition-ready feel configurations to match your preference.
